verifications.claim: Pokémon Champions launches on Nintendo Switch on April 8, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Pokémon Champions Releases on Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 on April 8, 2026'; R2: 'The release date for Pokémon Champions is Wednesday 8 April 2026, on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch consoles'; R3: 'Pokémon Champions will be released on Switch this Wednesday, April 8'; R4: 'Pokémon Champions arrives on Nintendo Switch on Wednesday, April 8, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact release date on Nintendo Switch.

verifications.claim: The iOS and Android mobile version of Pokémon Champions is scheduled for a later release.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'is available on Nintendo Switch systems and is coming to mobile devices in 2026'; R2: 'Both an Android and iOS mobile release is also in development, but will launch at a later date'; R3: 'set to be released on mobile devices'; R4: 'A mobile version of Pokémon Champions is also on the way'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm mobile (iOS/Android) release after Switch launch.

verifications.claim: The mobile version of Pokémon Champions has a potential release window in June 2026.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'a South Korean website... briefly listed June 2026 as the release window... It remains to be seen whether this will be confirmed'; title: 'expected to release on mobile devices in June'
verifications.reasoning: R3 supports June 2026 tentatively via leak; other sources mention 2026 but no month, making it less precise.

verifications.claim: The mobile release window for Pokémon Champions is expected in June 2026 based on leaked information.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'a South Korean website dedicated to the franchise briefly listed June 2026 as the release window'; 'MobileLeaks'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly attributes June 2026 to leaked info from a website.

verifications.claim: Pokémon Champions focuses on competitive, arena-style Pokémon battling.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'battle-focused game'; R2: 'focus entirely on Pokémon battles... centres on online competition, with Ranked, Casual, and Private Battles... Battle Arena'; R3: 'focus exclusively on Pokémon battles within an arena'; R4: 'intense Pokémon battles... Ranked Battles or Casual Battles'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently describe it as battle-focused, competitive (ranked/online), and arena-style.

verifications.claim: Pokémon Champions will feature cross-platform functionality at a later date.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'cross-platform play is planned across Nintendo Switch and mobile'; R4: 'battle cross-platform between Nintendo Switch and mobile devices'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm cross-platform between Switch and mobile, aligning with mobile's later release.
